thread: Rachel: Quick sync request — we need cross-team alignment on the 'Capacity Playbook v2' initiative before the 4/15 freeze. Primary asks: clear launch gates, sequencing for Dedicated pool + host fallback, and security audit checklist. Who can join a short 30m tomorrow 11:00? cc @Omar @Mei @Sam :calendar:
messages:
Rachel: Quick sync request — we need cross-team alignment on the 'Capacity Playbook v2' initiative before the 4/15 freeze. Primary asks: clear launch gates, sequencing for Dedicated pool + host fallback, and security audit checklist. Who can join a short 30m tomorrow 11:00? cc @Omar @Mei @Sam :calendar:
Omar: I can make 11. Main runtime concerns: warmup for KV cache, model-variant routing, and an ops plan to ramp GPUs. Need lead time for Dedicated pool spin-up (currently ~72h) — Mei can confirm infra timelines.
Mei: Confirmed — 72h for new Dedicated pools with current infra automation. We can shave to ~36h if we pre-provision staging VMs and have approvals. Also need network egress rules + NAT gateway planning for Private deployments.
Sam: Security checklist: KMS key provisioning + rotation, audit log retention (default 1y, can be 7y on request), and threat-model signoff. For any private deploy: must have a SOC-2 control review and an encryption-at-rest scan. Can we scope which customers require private early?
Dave: Product note — two customers already asked for private-only launch (ConfideAI, MedFlow). Let's treat them as early adopters; they need both Dedicated and Private options. We should bake a minimal launch checklist: 1) SLOs + cost guardrails, 2) canary + rollback, 3) security approvals, 4) docs + runbook.
Jen: From SRE side: propose launch SLOs: p50 < 30ms generation, p95 < 120ms for 2k-token windows, error rate < 0.5% over 1h. Canary plan: 5% traffic for 24h, automated rollback on p95 > 200ms or error > 1%. Need agreement on tracing tags and alert thresholds.
Omar: Runtime details: fallback model variant must be compatible with prompt schema (we'll use a small quantized model for fallback: `rwd-small-q4`). KV cache warmup: pre-warm on canary instances with top-100 prefixes. Also need to pin quantization profile and disable dynamic compilation during canary to avoid perf noise.
Mei: Infra ops checklist: pre-provision Dedicated pools for canary, script to scale from 2->8 replicas: `kubectl scale --replicas=8 deploy/redwood-runtime`. Add a healthcheck that validates KV cache hit rate > 40% within 10 minutes.
Sam: Security redlines: no default public S3 buckets, KMS keys must be separate per-customer for Private mode, and HSM optional for enterprise. For Dedicated hosted customers, require VPC peering or private endpoints. Also: encryption-in-transit TLS1.3 mandatory.
Rachel: Good. Two sequencing options: A) Parallel runway: infra pre-provisions staging pools while runtime finalizes fallback + telemetry; security does review in parallel (faster but more coordination). B) Sequential: security sign-off before infra provisioning (slower but lower rework). Which approach do we prefer?
Dave: Lean towards Parallel runway with hard gates — security must have a 24h turnaround on checklist items for canary to proceed. That keeps schedule but enforces discipline.
Omar: Agree but we need a gating step in the deployment pipeline: `deploy-bot` should block canary if security checklist flag != true.
Jen: I'll add automated checks to the CI/CD pipeline to verify p95 and error rate on smoke before shifting traffic. Also add an alert to paging if mem/cpu > 85% for 10m during canary.
Mei: I'll create infra PR to pre-provision the pools and add a runbook for manual rollback if autoscaling fails. ETA: PR by EOD today if we lock sequencing.
Sam: I'll run the threat-model with product docs and post the checklist link once it's done. Target: security checklist posted today EOD.
Rachel: Thanks — two action items: 1) Mei to open infra PR for pre-provision + runbook. 2) Omar + Jen to add runtime canary config + smoke tests. Security to post checklist. We'll meet tomorrow 11:00 to sign off. If any blockers, ping in-thread. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary job queued: capacity-playbook-v2/canary -> waiting on `security.checklist: true` and `infra.preprovision: merged`.
